title: Saudi Arabia property market faces short-term pressure
summary:
A property advisory firm has outlined the current state of the Saudi Arabian real estate market following recent regional security incidents, presenting economic forecasts showing a projected 3.3% contraction in 2026 followed by a 7.9% rebound in 2027.

title: DarGlobal announces seven FENDI Casa mansions in Riyadh
summary:
DarGlobal has announced seven mansions with FENDI Casa interiors at Rayana, Wadi Safar, marking the first FENDI Casa residential collection in Saudi Arabia. The six- and seven-bedroom homes on plots from 2,035 to 4,623 square metres are scheduled for completion in December 2029.

title: Foxtons shareholders reject board proposals at AGM
summary:
Foxtons Group has encountered significant shareholder opposition at its annual general meeting, with investors rejecting two board proposals on share issuance. Almost 39% of votes opposed plans to grant directors flexibility to issue new shares without offering them to existing shareholders first.

The post Foxtons shareholders reject board proposals at AGM appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Estate agency tech platform launches with cost-offset model
summary:
Iamproperty has launched a unified technology platform for estate agencies that claims to reduce or eliminate software costs through a revenue-sharing model. The platform consolidates services including auctions, conveyancing, CRM systems and property data into a single system.

The post Estate agency tech platform launches with cost-offset model appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Estate agency platform offers credit-based software model
summary:
Estate agency software provider iamproperty has launched a platform allowing agents to offset software costs through credits earned from transactions. The company has not disclosed the business volumes required to eliminate software costs or standard subscription prices.

The post Estate agency platform offers credit-based software model appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Free property packs launched to reduce transaction times
summary:
Estate agents and mortgage brokers can now access free property information packs through a new scheme from conveyancing firm YouConvey, which claims the service could reduce transaction times by up to five weeks. The initiative provides upfront property data without subscription fees or any requirement for clients to use YouConvey's conveyancing services.

title: HMRC guidance tightens AML compliance for self-employed agents
summary:
Self-employed estate agents and the networks they operate under face increased scrutiny of their anti-money laundering procedures following updated guidance from HMRC. The guidance clarifies how existing requirements apply to self-employed agents, home-based businesses, and franchise networks.

The post HMRC guidance tightens AML compliance for self-employed agents appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Landlords secure full rent increases in just 28% of cases
summary:
Landlords secured their full proposed rent increases in only 28.4% of tribunal cases during September 2026, according to analysis of 74 First-tier property tribunal decisions in England. The research found that 71.6% of cases ended with smaller increases than requested, no change, or reductions.

The post Landlords secure full rent increases in just 28% of cases appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Conveyancer shortage prompts recruitment drive for 2,000
summary:
The Council for Licensed Conveyancers has launched a campaign to recruit 2,000 additional conveyancers by 2030, addressing a workforce shortage that has seen numbers drop from 13,000 in 2021 to 10,000 currently. The initiative aims to reduce transaction delays and could support up to 400,000 more property transactions annually.

The post Conveyancer shortage prompts recruitment drive for 2,000 appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Lender provides £774,000 for Yorkshire hotel acquisition
summary:
A specialist lender has provided £774,000 in bridging finance for the acquisition of a mixed-use seafront property in East Yorkshire, completing the transaction in under two months. The 18-month facility was advanced at 90% loan-to-value against a purchase price of £860,000.
